whether separate normal Powers combine Damage
answers.answer: Damage marks a piece and destroys it at Health; Destroy returns it regardless of Health and earns 1 Fear for a Town or 2 for a City; Remove takes it off without destruction Fear; Replace swaps it and retains marked Damage, with Fear only if the new piece is then destroyed. Damage from separate normal Powers can accumulate within a turn. Normal Spirit Damage affects Invaders, not Dahan.

evidence.text:
### Damage, Destroy, Remove, Replace and Defend

Use the named operation to determine what happens to the piece:

| Instruction | Effect on the piece |
| --- | --- |
| **Damage** | Mark Damage; reaching Health destroys the piece immediately. |
| **Destroy** | Return the specified piece to supply regardless of Health or marked Damage. |
| **Remove** | Take the specified piece off the board without a Damage-to-Health test. |
| **Replace** | Remove the original piece and put the specified new piece in its place, retaining marked Damage. |

“Damage” means **Damage to Invaders** unless explicitly stated otherwise. Normal Spirit Damage does not harm Dahan or the land. Distribute Damage among Invaders in the target land however you wish; Explorers need not be hit first. Damage from separate normal Powers and counterattacks can accumulate within a turn. A piece is destroyed immediately when its marked Damage reaches/exceeds its Health. Reduced Health can also destroy a previously damaged piece; Damage does not itself reduce Health. Marked Damage does not reduce the Health counted by a Health-worth removal allowance. If a damaged piece moves out of a Health bonus or into a Health penalty and is thereby destroyed, destruction occurs in its destination land, never in an in-between location. [FAQ if-an-invader-with-health-bonus-and-damage-is-moved-where-is-it-destroyed]

**Destroy** returns pieces to supply regardless of Health when directly instructed. Every destroyed Town generates **1 Fear** and every destroyed City **2 Fear**, in addition to explicit Fear from the effect. Explorers generate none automatically. **Remove** returns the specified pieces without requiring Damage to reach their Health and without destruction Fear. Within the effect's count and piece-type restrictions, its decision-maker may choose any eligible pieces; there is no Explorer-first priority unless stated. **Replace** removes a piece and adds another, retaining its marked Damage: the replacement itself produces no Fear, but if the retained Damage destroys the new piece, destruction Fear applies normally. For simultaneous replacements, select all pieces before replacing any: the same original City cannot become a Town and then an Explorer within that one simultaneous instruction. Separate completed instructions or actions may replace the resulting piece again (e.g., successive players resolving **Trade Suffers** at Terror III).

**Defend N** reduces each occurrence of Invader Damage to both land and Dahan by N for this turn, to a minimum of zero. Multiple Defend effects add. It does not reduce Spirit Damage or make Dahan do less counterattack Damage. Land and Dahan receive the reduction separately, not by splitting a shared allowance. A protection explicitly limited to Dahan is different: **Concealing Shadows** makes Dahan take no Damage from Ravaging Invaders this turn, while land still takes its normal Damage and can Blight. Protected surviving Dahan then counterattack normally. It does not protect them from direct Destroy instructions or Damage from other sources. [FAQ .7w4g8nu; original card text]
